{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Apply mild recency weighting to masked-target supervision across all four datasets, retaining temperature 0.8, zero smoothing, and the existing single-model BERT4Rec architecture.","edits":[{"find":"    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits / 0.8, targets, reduction="mean")","replace":"    target_losses = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
        logits / 0.8, targets, reduction="none", label_smoothing=0.0
    )
    real_positions = seq.ne(0)
    ordinals = (real_positions.long().cumsum(dim=1) - 1).clamp_min(0)
    denominators = (real_positions.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) - 1).clamp_min(1)
    recency_weights = 1.0 + 0.5 * (
        ordinals.to(logits.dtype) / denominators.to(logits.dtype)
    )
    target_weights = recency_weights[mask]
    return (target_losses * target_weights).sum() / target_weights.sum()"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace uniform masked-target loss averaging with normalized recency weights ranging from 1 to 1.5. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged."}
